messages:
Maria: heads-up — nightly perf CI flagged a p95 regression on the canary pool (shadow traffic). Noticed ~30% increase vs baseline.
Ajay: thanks, can you paste the failing test name and the run id?
Maria: run id 2026-03-17T23:04Z, job=nightly-shadow-bench, test=batcher_small_batch_p95
CI-bot: ALERT: nightly-shadow-bench failed p95 threshold (delta +31%). Logs archived: https://ci.internal/runs/2026-03-17-2304
Sam: ok, quick triage plan: 1) reproduce locally with same config 2) collect perf profile 3) check recent commits touching scheduler/batcher
Lina: i pulled the logs. There's a repeated stacktrace where the scheduler backoff is triggering: "Scheduler::yield -> spin_wait -> sleep(40ms)" around the slow requests.
Devon: that points at the new yield heuristic we added last week (PR #2486). @Ajay can you check if the heuristic activates for small_batch workloads?
Ajay: on it. Running a quick local repro with nightly image and shadow traffic fixture. Will run `./scripts/run_shadow_bench --seed 42 --small-batch` and attach flamegraph.
Maria: flamegraph would be great. If it reproduces we should rollback the heuristic on canary and run a controlled canary split.
CI-bot: Debug artifact: /artifacts/2026-03-17-2304/profiler.tar.gz (contains perf.data and traces)
Sam: Devon/Lina — can one of you grab the perf.data and generate a folded stack? e.g., `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- ./bin/bench && perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl > out.folded` then `flamegraph.pl out.folded > flame.svg`
Lina: grabbing it now, ETA ~12m. Quick peek shows increased time in `spin_wait` and `KernelScheduler::select_yield`.
Devon: if it's the heuristic, we should gate it behind a flag and default back to previous behavior for canary until we confirm. I'll open a rollback PR if Ajay repros.
Ajay: reproed locally — p95 up ~28% with the new heuristic enabled. Flamegraph attached in thread (uploaded).
Maria: thanks. Rolling canary fallback: switch to old-yield policy, reduce canary traffic to 5% while we iterate.
Sam: create a short runbook comment in the rollback PR explaining the measurement and linking to the perf artifacts (run id + flamegraph). Also add a note to the nightly triage board.
Devon: pr opened: #2492 revert yield-heuristic, description + links to artifacts. Assigning @Lina for quick review.
Lina: reviewing now. If everything checks, i'll merge and we can kick a new canary deployment.
Maria: appreciate the fast loop. Follow-ups: 1) add a small-batch unit test that exercises the heuristic at scale 2) add perf regression alert to include flamegraph link in the alert 3) schedule post-mortem next week.
Sam: added to board.
CI-bot: STATUS: rollback merged to canary at 2026-03-18T00:12Z. New canary p95 looks back to baseline after one cycle.
Maria: closing out here unless anyone has other asks. :thumbsup:
Ajay: nits for follow-up PRs noted. Thanks team.
Devon: good catch, nice teamwork.
